Context: 4. Concessions for Family

## 4. Concessions for Family  
1. Definition.'Family' means employee's-
2. (i) Husband/Wife including more than one wife and also judicially separated wife.  
- (ii)
- Parents and Stepmother.  
In the case of adoption, only the adoptive and not the real parents.  
If the adoptive father has more than one wife, the first wife only.  
A female employee has a choice to include either her parents or her parents-in-law; option exercised can be changed only once during service.
